output.summary: Three small, independent behaviour changes with no code edges between them: cart totals are rounded to cents, the welcome message wording changes, and the default log level moves from debug to info. The commit has no single stated intent, so each change should be reviewed on its own.

groups.title: cartTotal rounds to two decimals
groups.description: cartTotal now rounds the sum to cents. Check that rounding the final sum, rather than each price, is intended and that callers expecting unrounded values still work.

groups.title: Default log level becomes info
groups.description: logLevel falls back to 'info' instead of 'debug' when LOG_LEVEL is unset. Confirm that quieter default logging is intended for all environments.

groups.title: Welcome message wording changes (looks unrelated)
groups.description: welcomeMessage now reads 'Welcome back, name!'. This looks unrelated to the other changes; check that no tests or translations depend on the old text.
